condition: gtr/ltr/outside return wrong results (often both true) when a comparator set in the range has two bounds on the same side, e.g. '>1.0.0 >=2.0.0 <3.0.0' or partial versions like '1.2 <1.2.9'.
workaround: Compare against the range's bounds yourself, e.g. !satisfies(v, r) && lt(v, minVersion(r)) for ltr, or make each comparator set have only one bound on each side.
